ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Moon and Mars at {H:1820053548000}

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on relationships and partnerships. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on routine, daily work and health. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up home and family.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on home and family. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on your money and what you value. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on rest and your inner life. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on friends and plans for the future. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on your career and your goals. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1820043842000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The Moon and Mars are together in {S:7}: emotion and intuition, courage and initiative, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.
